name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted media server for anime and manga with AniList sync, torrent and debrid streaming, a manga reader and a password-protected web UI.

alerts.message: The web UI asks for the server password: use the generated SEANIME_PASSWORD from the environment variables. On the setup screen, set the library path to /anime. AniList is optional; to link it from a remote domain, click Get AniList token and paste the token into the form.
